japanese_frog.scope: arithmetic endpoint combinations only; no empirical frequency or confidence interval

caveats: Three paired choice assays, each repeated five times; not 15 independently identified flies; trial-level identity and randomization unclear.
Whipped egg white differed in chemistry and texture as well as potential optical features. Hovering is not proof of purely visual attraction.
Stage distribution among infested nests lacks exposure denominators; not a stage-specific infestation probability.
Mortality comparison is observational with potential host/stage/collection confounding; not recipient fertilization.
Qualitative duration ranges at one historical study area, not distributional bounds or species-wide estimates.
The visible residue period does not establish chemical availability, continued insect use, or persistence after frog population-wide breeding cessation.
Seasonal count calibration includes repeated ponds/years and cannot be transferred without new validation.
